_doc: Tiers for the AI per-game config. allow = AI may change; risky = only with a curated precedent, flagged experimental; preference = user taste, AI never changes it; never = AI never changes it. Non-switchable (global) settings are excluded automatically. Keys missing here default to never.

never_reasons.enable_compute_pipelines: only affects Intel proprietary Windows drivers 0.405.0-0.405.285 (CheckBrokenCompute); no effect on our devices
never_reasons.backend: renderer backend; Vulkan only on our builds
never_reasons.program_args: raw arguments passed to the game

descriptions.use_multi_core: Run the emulated CPU cores on several host threads. Off is slower but fixes some timing-sensitive games.
descriptions.memory_layout_mode: Emulated RAM size (4 GB retail, 6/8 GB expanded). Larger helps some mods and heavy games, costs host RAM.
descriptions.astc_recompression: How ASTC textures are stored when the GPU cannot decode ASTC natively: Uncompressed (most VRAM, best quality), Bc1 or Bc3 (less VRAM, lower quality; needs BCn support, not on Mali).
descriptions.barrier_feedback_loops: Insert barriers when a texture is sampled while it is also a render target (feedback loop). Default on; turning off can be faster but may show corruption.
descriptions.frame_pacing_mode: Swapchain present pacing target: Auto, 30, 60, 90 or 120 fps.
descriptions.gpu_unswizzle_enabled: Decode block-linear 3D textures on the GPU instead of the CPU. Faster texture uploads in some games; experimental.
descriptions.use_video_framerate: While a hardware-decoded video plays, present at the video's frame rate.
descriptions.use_vulkan_driver_pipeline_cache: Keep the Vulkan driver's own pipeline cache on disk. Shorter compile stutter on later runs; a bad driver cache can cause crashes at boot.
descriptions.accelerate_astc: Decode ASTC textures with a compute shader on the GPU.
descriptions.nvdec_emulation: How in-game videos are decoded: off, CPU or GPU.
descriptions.vram_usage_mode: How aggressively the emulator keeps textures in VRAM before evicting.
descriptions.use_asynchronous_gpu_emulation: Run GPU emulation on its own thread.
descriptions.async_presentation: Present frames from a separate thread.
descriptions.use_fast_gpu_time: Report a faster GPU clock to the game so it may raise its dynamic resolution.
descriptions.cpuopt_fastmem: Map guest memory directly into host memory for faster access (debug CPU option; normally on).
descriptions.cpuopt_fastmem_exclusives: Use fastmem for exclusive memory accesses (debug CPU option; normally on).
descriptions.cpuopt_unsafe_fastmem_check: Skip bounds checks on fastmem accesses. Faster; out-of-range accesses can crash the game.
descriptions.cpuopt_unsafe_ignore_global_monitor: Skip the global exclusive monitor. Faster; can break games that rely on atomics across cores.
descriptions.cpuopt_unsafe_ignore_standard_fpcr: Ignore the guest floating-point control register's standard mode. Faster; changes float results.
descriptions.cpuopt_unsafe_inaccurate_nan: Do not emulate exact NaN payloads. Faster; can break physics in rare games.
descriptions.cpuopt_unsafe_reduce_fp_error: Use host approximations for reciprocal/sqrt estimates. Faster; changes float results.
descriptions.cpuopt_unsafe_unfuse_fma: Split fused multiply-add into two operations. Faster on some hosts; changes float rounding.
descriptions.use_docked_mode: Emulate the console docked (higher game resolution, more GPU load) or handheld.
